label: DeepSeek curl — capybara as compact C
revised_prompt: Official product app-icon logo mark, not a painting, not a photo. Design language identical to DeepSeek's famous whale logo: flat minimalist two-tone vector, clever negative space, a single organic creature curled into a tight almost-circular C-shape, balanced compact icon that fits a square frame. Subject: a stylized capybara (not a whale, not an orca, not a bear, not a hippo). Translate the capybara's stout barrel body, blunt rounded snout, tiny rounded ear, and calm personality into smooth geometric curves. Deep navy blue body (#0A2342) with white negative-space belly sweeping through the curve. One small white oval eye-spot near the head, like DeepSeek's orca mark but on a capybara. Tail is a tiny rounded stub, not a whale fluke. No dorsal fin. Pure white background, generous padding around the mark, centered. No text, no letters, no wordmark, no 3D, no gloss, no gradient, no shadows, no photorealism, no whiskers, no fur texture. Modern tech brand identity, high contrast, vector-crisp edges, favicon-readable silhouette. Ultra high resolution.

label: Grok geometry — capybara bot head
revised_prompt: Official product app-icon logo mark in the design philosophy of xAI Grok: extreme geometric simplification, high-contrast two-tone, almost-abstract mascot that still reads instantly. A capybara head reduced to a few perfect curves and one or two negative-space cuts: blunt rounded snout, tiny half-circle ears, calm slit or oval eye, stout cheeks. Looks like a smart calm companion bot, not a cartoon, not a 3D character, not a plush toy. Flat vector, deep navy (#0B1F3A) on pure white. Centered square composition with padding. No text, no letters, no Grok logo copy, no X logo, no photorealism, no fur, no gradient, no 3D bevel. Tech-oriented, modern, friendly but restrained. Ultra high resolution.

label: Sitting silhouette — negative-space belly
revised_prompt: Minimalist two-tone vector logo of a capybara sitting in profile, designed like DeepSeek's whale: one continuous navy shape, white negative space carving the belly and snout. Side view, compact, almost filling a circle: rounded rump, short legs tucked in, blunt snout lifted slightly, tiny ear, tiny white eye. Calm, grounded, coworker energy — a peaceful work companion. Deep navy blue (#0A2342) and white only. Pure white background, centered, lots of padding. Flat vector app icon, no text, no 3D, no fur, no photorealism, no scenery, no sofa. Silhouette must remain readable at 32px. Ultra high resolution, crisp edges.

label: Letter C — capybara forms Cowork C
revised_prompt: Logo mark where a stylized capybara body IS the letter C, for the product Cowork. The stout capybara curls so its spine and snout complete a perfect C letterform, DeepSeek-style negative space for the white belly inside the C. Tiny ear and a small white eye-spot make it read as a capybara, not a generic crescent. Flat two-tone vector: deep navy (#0A2342) and white. Pure white background, centered square, padding. No other letters, do not write the word Cowork, no 3D, no gradient, no photorealism. Premium tech brand icon, geometric yet organic, favicon-clear. Ultra high resolution.

label: App icon tile — navy rounded square
revised_prompt: iOS / macOS app icon for Cowork. A rounded-square icon (superellipse, like Apple app icons) filled with deep navy blue. Centered on it: a white flat-vector capybara mark in DeepSeek negative-space style, curled compactly, stout snout, tiny ear, small eye, readable at small size. The icon sits centered on a light gray (#F4F4F5) studio background so we can see the rounded corners. No text, no skeuomorphism, no 3D capybara, no glossy blob, no photoreal fur. Clean product design, high contrast, production app-icon quality. Ultra high resolution.

label: Lockup — mark + Cowork wordmark
revised_prompt: Horizontal brand lockup for Cowork, an AI collaboration desktop app. Left: a DeepSeek-style flat two-tone navy-and-white capybara icon (stout body, blunt snout, negative-space belly, tiny ear). Right: the word 'Cowork' in a clean geometric sans-serif, medium-bold, navy, optically aligned with the icon. Generous spacing between mark and type. Pure white background, centered, lots of padding. No tagline, no slogan, no extra icons, no 3D, no gradient, no photorealism. Looks like a real SaaS header logo. Ultra high resolution, vector-crisp.
